title: Restore a real liveness check for cached Engram control processes
outcome: ProcessEngramControlTransport::process_for (src/engram_host_adapter.rs:1242) now validates a cached control process only by the worker-set worker_finished flag, replacing the previous try_wait() check. The flag is set only by the worker thread (terminal error, idle timeout, disconnect). If the Engram child dies on its own (crash, OOM, external kill) while the worker is parked in recv_timeout, a dead process is handed back and the next control call fails with a transport error that renders a degraded control card and increments the circuit breaker, where the old code respawned transparently. Keep try_wait() as an additional liveness condition alongside worker_finished and add a test that kills the sidecar out-of-band and asserts the next request respawns instead of failing. Found by the Claude delegated reviewer (Medium).
